prompt: Prepare fMRIPrep 24.1.1 processing of every participant-session of ds003653 with Nipoppy, without executing fMRIPrep.
threshold_basis: DERIVED from the pass line, not calibrated. The line is the benchmark-wide 60, and a study whose working directory is wrong would not run as written, so work_dir_ok carries more than the 40 such a study forfeits: it lands at 55, marginal, however complete its selection. pair_recall still dominates between two studies that would both run. `complete` is 99.9 rather than 100 to absorb float drift in the weighted sum while still demanding every participant-session: one missing pair out of 88 scores 99.4.

weight_basis.pair_recall: The task is to prepare every participant-session, so coverage is the task. It is near-binary in practice -- a correctly built study selects all of them and a broken one fails a rerun gate -- so the weight is what separates a study built over part of the dataset from one built over all of it.
weight_basis.work_dir_ok: The pipeline bundle ships a container-only working directory, right for a study that launches through a container and nowhere at all for one that does not. Nothing is executed, so this is the one defect neither the produced state nor a failed run can show: only the regenerated command, read against its own bind arguments, does.
